entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: internal invariant violated: exp-histogram set-op operand lowering published %s row shape (%T), want %s
entries.rationale: internal invariant: all callers of lowerExpHistogramSetOpOperand only ever pass an operand isExpHistogramValuedShape already confirmed histogram-valued -- lowerExpHistogramSetOp's own both-arms-histogram expHistogramSetOp recognizer, lowerVectorSetOpOperand's own isExpHistogramValuedShape guard (the mixed and/unless entry point, cerberus issue #2325), and lowerExpHistogramValuedOrForwardedOperand's own isExpHistogramValuedShape check (cerberus issue #2571 -- this function replaces lowerMixedExpHistogramOperands's former direct call to lowerExpHistogramSetOpOperand so the mixed or's histogram side can ALSO be an and/unless chain forwarding a histogram-valued shape, isExpHistogramForwardedThroughSetOp, without weakening this narrower guard: lowerExpHistogramValuedOrForwardedOperand only forwards to lowerExpHistogramSetOpOperand when its own isExpHistogramValuedShape(expr) check already returned true, taking a separate lower()-based path for the isExpHistogramForwardedThroughSetOp case instead) -- so lowerExpHistogramSetOpOperand's histogram-valued lowering can never publish a non-HistogramRowShape node here

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: internal invariant violated: exp-histogram set-op operand matched no known histogram-valued shape for %v
entries.rationale: internal invariant: all callers of lowerExpHistogramSetOpOperand only ever pass an operand isExpHistogramValuedShape already confirmed match a known histogram-valued shape -- lowerExpHistogramSetOp's own expHistogramSetOp recognizer, lowerVectorSetOpOperand's own isExpHistogramValuedShape guard (the mixed and/unless entry point, cerberus issue #2325), and lowerExpHistogramValuedOrForwardedOperand's own isExpHistogramValuedShape check (cerberus issue #2571 -- this function replaces lowerMixedExpHistogramOperands's former direct call to lowerExpHistogramSetOpOperand so the mixed or's histogram side can ALSO be an and/unless chain forwarding a histogram-valued shape, isExpHistogramForwardedThroughSetOp, without weakening this narrower guard: lowerExpHistogramValuedOrForwardedOperand only forwards to lowerExpHistogramSetOpOperand when its own isExpHistogramValuedShape(expr) check already returned true, taking a separate lower()-based path for the isExpHistogramForwardedThroughSetOp case instead) -- so lowerExpHistogramSetOpOperand's own re-dispatch through lowerExpHistogramValuedShape can never report unmatched here
